 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Draw a color-3 horizontal separator through the blank row between 2-shapes."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    height = len(grid)
    width = len(grid[0]) if height else 0
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if all(cell == 0 for cell in row):
            has_2_above = any(2 in grid[rr] for rr in range(r))
            has_2_below = any(2 in grid[rr] for rr in range(r + 1, height))
            if has_2_above and has_2_below:
                out[r] = [3] * width
                break
    return out
